title: Secluded Sanctuary By the Sea | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Secluded Sanctuary By the Sea is a 4.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Ready for a coastal stay that’s close to Seacrest shops, dining, and the beach?Secluded Sanctuary By the Sea is a thoughtfully designed home with 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, perfect for up to 8 guests. One of the standout features of this pet-friendly property is the included 6-seater gas powered golf cart, giving you quick and easy access to the beach, shops, and nearby dining without the hassle of parking. Public beach access is just blocks away, so you can enjoy the sand and surf anytime. You’ll also enjoy a screened-in heated pool, a shaded outdoor dining area, and spacious areas to gather, rest, and recharge. Spend your mornings biking along scenic 30A, relax by the pool in the afternoon, and explore local restaurants in the evening. For your peace of mind, the property is secured with cameras, letting you enjoy your stay with confidence.Inside, the open concept living area offers a comfortable place to unwind after a day of coastal adventures. A large TV and ample seating make it ideal for movie nights or casual hangouts. The kitchen is fully equipped for home cooked meals and features an island with four bar stools, Keurig, coffee maker, toaster, and a refrigerator with an ice maker. A separate dining area seats seven, and a laundry space with a vanity cabinet adds extra convenience for extended stays.Sleeping Arrangements:Master Bedroom: King bed, TV, sofa, office setup, and private bath with double vanities, soaking tub, and walk-in showerBedroom 2: King bed, TV, and private bath with walk-in showerBedroom 3: King bed, TV; shares a bathroom (shower/tub combo) with Bedroom 4Bedroom 4: Queen bed, TV; shares a bathroom (shower/tub combo) with Bedroom 3Outdoor Amenities:Start your day on the covered porch with coffee from the Keurig before exploring the local farmer’s market or biking through nearby beach towns. Back home, fire up the grill and enjoy outdoor dining on the spacious back patio with ample seating for the group. The shaded backyard, surrounded by tall trees, offers privacy and a comfortable place to spend time outdoors, complete with a convenient outdoor refrigerator for drinks and ingredients. The screened-in private pool is available year-round, with optional heating for an additional fee, and is ideal for a refreshing swim before or after a day at the beach, just a 10-minute walk away via public beach access.Nearby Attractions:This home offers convenient access to the best of the 30A lifestyle. Just a few minutes away, The Big Chill (formerly The Hub) offers live music, an outdoor cinema, food trucks, and shaded picnic areas, great for families and groups. George’s at Alys Beach is known for its refined coastal cuisine, while La Crema and Cowgirl Kitchen in Rosemary provide casual yet flavorful options. For dessert, kids and adults alike will enjoy a stop at Sugar Shack, a local favorite for candy and ice cream. Need bikes or beach gear? Peddlers Pavilion offers rentals along with boutique shopping and casual eateries. A short drive brings you to 30Avenue, home to stylish restaurants like Amici (Italian), Amigos (Mexican), and Idyll Proper (brunch + craft drinks). Also nearby is Watersound Town Center, featuring beloved local spots like Ambrosia, Nigel’s Bananas, Sweet Henrietta’s Bakery, and The Village Market for groceries and essentials.Your stay at Secluded Sanctuary By the Sea comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!Additional Information:* Pool heating is available for an additional fee.* Snowbird Friendly!* Parking for 4 cars only.* Golf carts are permitted.* Dog Friendly: Up to 2 dogs (max 30 lbs) allowed with a non-refundable pet fee. Please contact us before booking. See rental policies for details.* Security cameras: One Eufy doorbell camera at the front entrance and two cameras on the front corners of the house. Motion-detecting lights are installed on the back corners of the property for extra nighttime visibility.Benchmark starter amenities include kitchen essentials (paper towels, sponge, dish soap, etc.), basic toiletries in each bathroom, and towels (1 body towel and washcloth per guest, 2 hand towels per bathroom).
